text.description_html:
AHI SIG106/SIG200PA-902/120, Windward Lever Set with Round Rose and Spindle

There is something utterly modern about the AHI made Windward Stainless Steel Leverset. The combination of contemporary arched design with the sleek lines and the satin stainless steel finish makes this lever perfect for even the most modern of spaces.This set is packaged with 2 levers, 2 rosettes, and a spindle. It does not include a latch, subrose, or strike plate.

Specifications of the Stainless Steel Windward Lever Pair with Spindle:

  • Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Lever Length: 5-1/2" (139 mm)
  • Lever Thickness: 3/4" (19 mm)
  • Projection: 2-7/8" (60 mm)
  • Spindle Width: 5/16" (8 mm)
  • Rose Diameter: 2-1/16" (52 mm)
  • Rose Thickness: 7/16" (11 mm)

Package Includes: a pair (2) SIG106 levers, a pair (2) of SIG200 round roses, and (1) 8mm x 120mm spindle

Special Ordered Item. No Returns
